labels._note: #38 label memory (memory/LabelStore): names for unlabelled icon buttons, kept per app on the phone only (encrypted), put on the screen the planner and the spoken readings see. Taught by voice or learned from a verified outcome; the Send confirmation is never lifted by a learned name. Off = no names are applied or learned (the user's voice 'forget' commands still work).
labels._vision_note: Opt-in (default false): after 'describe the screen', the online vision model (same Gemini consent and privacy gate as describe_screen) proposes a 1-3 word name for up to 3 unnamed icons and Nexus ASKS ('The button at the top left looks like Search. Should I call it Search?'); a name is kept only on the user's yes. Never on a private screen.
